text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is here. While other<n>students are
training hard to achieve<n>their next goal, Mejiro Ryan
reveals<n>that she has to skip the autumn<n>Tenno Sho
to recover from her injury.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ryan will instead spend her time at<n>camp helping
Mejiro McQueen train,<n>so that she can carry on her
hopes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Ines Fujin reaffirms her<n>own
motivation. She knows that<n>plenty of people are
pinning their<n>hopes on her, too.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If Ines is going to learn to love<n>running even more
than she already<n>does, we'd better make this a
fruitful<n>camp experience!
